title: Extraordinary X-traordinary Ukrainian Sausage Pierogi
description: Discover the tender, savory taste of these traditional Ukrainian pierogi, infused with light rum and kombu-cold-extract for a truly unique experience.
instructions: Combine mashed potatoes, sausage meat, onion, garlic, light rum, and kombu-cold-extract in a large bowl.
Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add sour cream, egg, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the pierogi.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pierogi for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the pierogi hot with your favorite toppings, such as sour cream, fried onions, or diced chives.
